{{Wireless adapter |brand=Gemtek |model=WUBB-160G |revision= |upc= |ean= |asin= |price= |est_release_date= |fcc_date=09/23/2005 |manuf_country=Taiwan |is_manuf=Yes |manuf= |manuf_model= |manuf_rev= |availability= |if=USB (non-standard) |if_bus_version= |if_connector_type=Male A |form_factor=corded dongle, battery-powered |vendor_id= |device_id= |subvendor_id= |subdevice_id= |id_string= |fcc_id=MXF-U940829G |ic_id=3069B-WUBB160G |chip1_brand=Broadcom |chip1_model=BCM4712 |chip2_brand=Broadcom |chip2_model=BCM2050 |chip3_brand= |chip3_model= |chip4_brand= |chip4_model= |addl_chips= |accessible_UART=No |flags= |ant_conn= |802dot11_protocols=bg |txchains= |rxchains= |sstreams= |oui=00:90:B5 |lin_driver=none |win_driver=none }} Also known as the [[Nikon PD-10]] and [[Fotonation CWPD]].
The device is battery powered and meant to be used with a select few photo printers. It requires both buttons to be pressed on the device simultaneously to be recognized by a host computer and will then start up in 'PTP' mode.
The Nikon device uses an ad-hoc connection with the SSID being 'NIKON Wireless Print'.
